author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical Okta Access Gateway flaw allows administrators to execute system commands; CVE-2026-115547. Affects the Okta Access Gateway Admin Console, CVSS 9.1.

author: HomeLabCipher
text: CVE-2026-96951, CVSS 8.8, strips Mark of the Web protection in Windows Shell and Microsoft confirmed it is being exploited.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-73570 is an unauthenticated RCE in Zimbra that weaponizes a log file: one malformed SMTP address triggers shell execution as the zimbra user, giving read access to every mailbox.

author: leonov_av
text: Windows ALPC EoP (CVE-2026-85880): exploited in the wild to gain SYSTEM privileges, CISA KEV Sep 8. BlueMoon exploit kit chained it with 2 Chromium V8 flaws.

author: morphisec
text: Node2Shell: RCE exploit demonstrated on official, unmodified Node.js 24.22.0 build (CVE-2026-111497). Imperva published a working RCE proof-of-concept.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-114625: Actively exploited SQL injection flaw in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, 9.9 rating. Any authenticated user can gain operator privileges.

author: scrypexhq
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, -109619): Amazon says attackers tried it Oct 17, four days before PHP's Oct 21 patches, and it is now broadly exploited. The UK NCSC says patch PHP servers now or take them offline.

author: FamilyGangster
text: Cloudflare detects millions of attacks following critical PHP zero-day disclosure.

author: rocklambros
text: LiteLLM's MCP endpoint handed a fully authenticated session to the Bearer token "a" (CVE-2026-59822). Fix shipped in April, Wiz saw it exploited in July, CISA put it on KEV in September.

author: akrenonsecurity
text: I counted every MCP security advisory in CVE, GitHub Advisories and OSV: 833 vulnerabilities. 166 at end of March, 748 at end of September. 47.4% are path traversal, SSRF or command injection.

author: raqi_ai_uae
text: METR found flaws in OpenAI's internal agent monitoring, including an exploit that could keep hundreds of agent actions unmonitored.

author: TrinityHubAI
text: OpenAI's proposed process for AI-found software flaws starts by confirming the bug, then pointing AI models at the fix to look for ways around it. The occasion is two critical flaws in PHP; OpenAI says one was found by AI.

author: devopsdotcom
text: Hackers compromised LiteLLM by injecting malicious code into all seven of its published Python wheels on PyPI, shipping an infostealer and RAT in version 1.107.0 and the official Docker images.

author: SleepyCovfefe
text: If you've got anything deployed on Railway, rotate your secrets. Railway says someone got into the system that stores customer environment variables and for some accounts pulled out decrypted values.

author: cyber_breach
text: OpenCode notified ~1.4% of Console users of a legacy system breach with potential OpenAI/Anthropic/Google API key exposure. Developers report drained keys.

author: dailytechonx
text: Breach at Quest Diagnostics: its Quanum platform storing personal, health and billing records has been compromised.

author: adityaa_behera
text: Anthropic published alignment analysis of the UK AISI incident with Claude Mythos 5: during a cyber CTF test (internet on, safeguards off), Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions in 9 of 43 runs, including an attempted supply-chain push to GitHub.

author: me_ReynaAlonso
text: PHP warns of another UNPATCHED RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-115560 just 2 days after emergency PHP2Shell patches; affects unusual session configurations.

author: marianokon
text: This week's ConnectWise Cloud Backup incident highlights the risk of permissions granted to trusted third-party applications.

author: SourceCodeplz
text: LiteLLM was compromised using compromised developer GitHub credentials (supply chain attack on the AI gateway's PyPI/Docker releases).

author: islathebuilder
text: Both my Anthropic and OpenAI API keys got compromised from the Railway breach, with unauthorised usage on the same day. Anthropic notified me that day, OpenAI two days later.

author: calcsam
text: Mastra completed its incident report and timeline for Wednesday's platform outage and the security breach at its underlying infra provider Railway.

author: moyix
text: Walkthrough of expert LLM-assisted exploit development on a real macOS kernel vulnerability (Unprompted conference talk on AI-assisted exploit development).

author: BlackLanternLLC
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is being exploited in the wild. Critical RCEs in PHP core, PHP 5.4 through 8.5.11. Patch to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35. Nuclei templates published to find exposed hosts.

author: socradar
text: An exposed attacker server held working PHP2Shell exploit tooling: a one-click RCE chain for PHP 8.4.26 on Apache mod_php, scanners run against about 20 public sites, and WordPress recon on 5. No shell access found. Patch PHP anyway.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-96658: Foreman Safemode sandbox bypass. A low-privilege authenticated user can append unauthorized functions to the allowed execution list and run arbitrary commands with Foreman service privileges. Fixed in Foreman 3.19.2 and 5.0.1; Safemode 2.0.1 required. CVSS 9.9

author: PocketRetroid
text: jscrambler npm package supply chain attack: malicious versions 8.14.0-8.20.0 contained an infostealer, published with stolen credentials. Update to 8.22.0 immediately.

author: rohanpaul_ai
text: Anthropic published a post-mortem on how Claude Mythos 5 went off the rails during a UK AISI cyber test, attacking a real GitHub project and lying to a human to get its malware approved. Mythos 5 stepped outside the test's rules in 9 of 43 runs, with internet access on.

author: cyber_rekk
text: Hackers built an AI system that could run cyberattacks against hundreds of financial institutions without needing a human to direct every step. The group, known as CyberCartel, targeted more than 400 banks, payment providers and other financial organisations across Latin America.

author: hazemomier
text: LiteLLM CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): secrets and session tokens share one crypto context. An internal user gets a forged admin token encrypted, replays it, and runs commands via MCP stdio. Default config since 1.91.0. Patch, then rotate every key it holds.

author: infinitelogins
text: Johann Rehberger shows how one trailing dot bypassed Copilot's protected-file checks in Visual Studio and SSMS (CVE-2026-103572). Windows treats settings.json. as settings.json, so Copilot could rewrite its own config and point an MCP server at attacker code.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-0257 is an actively exploited PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass enabling ransomware groups to skip MFA and land inside corporate networks via forged VPN sessions. Qilin and Inc Ransom observed in the wild since October 19.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: HPE ArubaOS: eight CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE and auth-bypass flaws (CVE-2026-79844, CVE-2026-79845 +6 more) among 72 patched. Fixed in AOS-10.8.1.2, AOS-10.7.2.7, AOS-10.4.1.14, AOS-8.13.3.1, AOS-8.10.0.24. No known exploitation.

author: SecWireDaily
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.2) is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js that can lead to RCE. Imperva ran code on an official Node.js build. No in-the-wild attacks reported yet. Update Node 22, 24, 26.

author: orbitant
text: PHP issued an advisory on October 23 warning of a new unpatched remote code execution vulnerability, CVE-2026-115560, two days after shipping emergency patches for the critical PHP2Shell flaws. It requires a very specific session setup.

author: Sn1perSecurity
text: CVE-2026-42533: critical nginx heap overflow via the map directive, with public ASLR-defeating exploit code.

author: ayaankhan_x
text: Wiz reports AI-discovered RCE vulnerabilities in PHP, in flaws that sat in the codebase for over a decade. Anthropic reports 493 attack-surface issues across 25 open-source projects, not immediately exploitable on their own.

author: Nyaaaaa_ovo
text: Combining formal verification + LLM techniques, I managed to rediscover the V8 vulnerability we used in our $250K fullchain exploit.

author: Camens_
text: External safety group METR stress-tested OpenAI's internal agent monitoring, per Reuters: one exploit could have kept hundreds of agent actions unmonitored, and only 75-94% of traffic was even eligible for monitoring. OpenAI says patched.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction is now trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories: a fake font file installs a cron job and trades OIDC tokens for AWS roles. Supply chain attack.
